name: Moncler x Zellerfeld
story: Moncler’s Trailgrip sole, printed rather than moulded, with Zellerfeld. The khaki pair is in the vault and on its product page. Trainers stay off the hanger rail.

name: Moncler Genius x Palm Angels
story: A guest chapter of Moncler Genius with Palm Angels. The black jacket on the rail is Vestiaire listing 72059216. The seller left the style name blank.

name: Palace x Oakley
story: Palace and Oakley, from the late-2010s hardware and snow work through the FW24 logo hood. That hood is not on the public rail.

name: BAPE x ASUS
story: The Vivobook S 15 OLED in a BAPE skin. The eBay UK listing was visible in search; the product page itself blocked a direct fetch.

name: Louis Vuitton LV Ice
story: The LV Ice snowboard, limited to 200. We have the retail reference, not a resale listing.

name: Stone Island x Dior
story: Dior and Stone Island, 2024, Kim Jones on a technical Stone Island cloth. It is a desk target, not a jacket on the public rail.

name: Stone Island Ghost
story: Ghost pieces are dyed after the seams are in, so the compass only reads up close. The grey 4100044 on the rail is a live Farfetch listing. The photograph is a retailer packshot of that same jacket, because the listing frame showed a model.

name: Louis Vuitton skis
story: Monogram skis, kept with the LV Ice board as sports objects. No resale listing is pinned.

name: Louis Vuitton x Nike
story: The 2022 Air Force 1 collaboration. It is a desk comp, not a pair on the public rail.

name: Audemars Piguet x Travis Scott
story: The Royal Oak collaboration. It stays on the desk. Watches are not on the public rail.

name: Supreme x Stone Island
story: Supreme and Stone Island have cut jackets together for years. The black synthetic jacket on the rail is one live Vestiaire listing, 69748871. The seller did not name the season.
